question: If four wires of the same material are connected like beads of a rosary, then the equivalent resistance of this rosary is □( )
solution:
The correct answer is __**will be four times**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• When wires are connected in series, the equivalent resistance is the sum of the individual resistances.
 
• If each wire has a resistance of R, then four wires connected in series will have a total resistance of 4R.
 
• This is because the current has to pass through each resistor sequentially, adding their resistances together.
 
• The equivalent resistance being four times indicates that the resistance adds up linearly when elements are connected in series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Resistance (R)**

 
 
• Resistance is a measure of the opposition to current flow in an electrical circuit.
 
• It is measured in ohms (Ω).
 
• Ohm's Law states that V = IR, where V is voltage, I is current, and R is resistance.
 
• Materials with high resistance are used as resistors in circuits to control current flow.
 
 
 
• **Series Connection**
 
 
• When components are connected end-to-end, they are said to be in series.
 
• In a series circuit, the current is the same through all components, but the voltage is divided among them.
 
• The total resistance in a series circuit is the sum of the individual resistances: R_total = R1 + R2 + R3 + ...
 
 
 
• **Equivalent Resistance**
 
 
• Equivalent resistance is the single resistance that can replace a group of resistances without changing the current or voltage in the circuit.
 
• For resistors in series, it is the sum of their resistances.
 
• For resistors in parallel, the reciprocal of the equivalent resistance is the sum of the reciprocals of the individual resistances: 1/R_total = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + 1/R3 + ...
